prayerExcerpt.en-US: On the day before he was to suffer, he took bread in his holy and venerable hands.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Na véspera de sua paixão, ele tomou o pão em suas santas e veneráveis mãos.

meta.face: A clean-shaven young man of about thirty with a smooth oval face — a long, straight nose running down from the brow on a narrow bridge, large dark almond-shaped eyes under high, arched brows, smooth cheekbones, a small rounded chin and a small, full mouth; short chestnut hair combed forward in a straight fringe, and a serene, open gaze. Straight hair, not curls.
meta.basis: The 8th-century fresco of 'Sanctus Alexander Papa' in Santa Maria Antiqua, Rome: a beardless young pope with short hair, large eyes, a white pallium and a jewelled book. The Breviary lesson gives the Qui pridie and the holy water.
meta.excerpt: content/of/order/order-of-mass.json, Roman Canon (Eucharistic Prayer I), institution narrative (en-US lines 106 and 108, pt-BR lines 103 and 105, rubrics omitted); the Roman Breviary lesson for 3 May credits him with adding 'Qui pridie quam pateretur' to the Canon
